frames.heading: Mojo
frames.body: Wow! You guys sure know how to keep a groove going! Mexico, you've been incredible!

frames.heading: Fan
frames.body: You brought the funk, Mojo! We loved every second!

frames.heading: Fan
frames.body: Where to next? Are you really going to the Moon?

frames.heading: Mojo
frames.body: Absolutely! I'll be bringing the Earth funk to the lunar base. And I want all of you to spread the word!

frames.heading: Fan
frames.body: We'll shout it from the rooftops! Funk in space!

frames.heading: Mojo
frames.body: Keep the energy alive, Mexico! You've shown me the power of music and connection.

frames.heading: Mojo
frames.body: I'll be back to funk it up again! Until then, keep dancing!
